alert.title: Admin Proximity Alert
alert.body: Someone with a clipboard is two doors down and moving with intent.

arrival.title: AP Reyes
arrival.body: She takes the seat by the door without being asked. Clipboard open before she sits down.

toast.title: Posted objective
toast.body: You flip the board to today's actual date. Nobody in this room has seen it do that before.

toast.title: Higher-order question
toast.body: You ask one with more than one right answer. Two hands go up. Neither is right, but they went up.

toast.title: Wait time
toast.body: You count to five in your head and say nothing out loud. It is the longest five seconds of your career.

toast.title: Student-led discourse
toast.body: You step back and let them talk to each other instead of to you. Three of them actually do.

conclusion.full: She checks the last box without looking up. Five for five.
conclusion.partial: She writes something for a while. You cannot see the tense of it from here.
conclusion.empty: She writes for a while, unprompted. That is somehow worse than a question.

conference.title: Post-Conference
conference.prompt: AP Reyes: “I noticed only about four students spoke during the discussion. Talk to me about your engagement strategy.”

options.label: “You're right — I want to build in more structured turn-and-talks.”
options.blurb: Fidelity +, and you now owe a follow-up.
options.result: She writes “follow-up” and underlines it twice. You have just promised her a specific Tuesday.

options.label: “Those four were the ones who'd read it.”
options.result: She looks up from the clipboard for the first time all conference. It is not clear yet whether that was a mistake.

options.label: “That's a great point, I'll add it to my growth plan.”
options.blurb: Free. Hollow. Bandwidth −, from the small death inside.
options.result: She nods and writes something down. You will never know what it was.

report.head: Observation
report.honest: You told her the truth about the discussion. That is worth more than it paid out today.
